story.title: Terminate all coverage for a subscriber
story.description: An 834 maintenance type TERM ends the subscriber coverage and every active dependent on that contract as of the termination date.
acceptanceCriteria: The subscriber coverage end date is the termination date on the 834.
Every active dependent on the contract is ended on the same date.

analysis.summary: TERM for the subscriber ends the subscriber and every dependent. The outcome is ACCEPTED.
